_notes: Stage written as range 'II-IIIA' -> labeled [II, IIIA]. EGFR mutation excludes -> excluded_if_positive. Squamous appears in both inclusion and exclusion text but captured once in histology_excluded, not duplicated in unstructured. Large-cell -> large_cell (in enum); Pancoast and sarcomatoid not in histology enum -> histology_excluded. Prior-therapy exclusions captured via treatment_naive_required=true rather than excluded_prior_treatments. Age/sex from CTgov structured fields, added to raw text since pipeline feeds them to the parser.
trial_title: Preoperative Sintilimab Combined With Bevacizumab and Chemotherapy for Resectable Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
unstructured_inclusion: Adequate preoperative laboratory testing and pulmonary function for surgery
Patient approves and signs informed consent
unstructured_exclusion: Active autoimmune disease or history of autoimmune disease
Condition requiring systemic treatment with prednisone or other immunosuppressive medication
History of symptomatic interstitial lung disease
History of allergy to study drug components
Men with female partners unwilling to use contraception
Mental or psychological condition preventing study completion or comprehension
Major hemoptysis within the past 4 weeks, or tumor invasion of / proximity to great vessels
Arterial thrombotic events, esophageal varices, peptic ulcers, wounds or bone fractures
HIV, HBV, HCV infection or active pulmonary tuberculosis
Underlying medical conditions that, per investigator opinion, make study drug administration hazardous or obscure toxicity interpretation
